from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Single legal document found in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment or ruling document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) stated in the document")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broad nature of the case, e.g. 'Civil', 'Criminal', or specific terms like '民事案件', '刑事案件'")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document, e.g. '判决书', '裁定书', '决定书'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all parsed documents in the collection."""
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
